Dear Mr. Harris,

Re: Account reference: ACC-578987

We received your dispute regarding the account with our agency, Bridgeport Recovery Inc. You have disputed that the debt has already been paid. We acknowledge your dispute and will investigate this matter further.

According to our records, the original creditor for this account is TruConnect Services, and the account was charged off on February 14, 2020. We do not have any record of a payment being made on this account. The current balance on this account is $5,203.33.

As per the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), we are required to provide you with validation of the debt. We will send you a validation notice with the required information, including the amount of the debt, the name of the creditor, and a statement that unless you dispute the debt within 30 days after receiving the notice, we will assume the debt is valid.

Please note that we will not continue collection efforts on this account until we have received your response to the validation notice. You have the right to dispute the debt and request that we cease collection efforts.

If you have any further questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Sincerely,

Bridgeport Recovery Inc.
